verdict.rationale: mParticle shows rule-like automation tied to incoming event data. Its forwarding rules conditionally block or route events, for example 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present' (x3). Audiences built from event behavior can be connected to outputs for automatic activation (x2), and the AI-assisted 'describe the audience, journey' flow suggests logic (docs-22). However, the evidence never documents a general event-triggered rules or actions engine; the transformation and journey material is mostly titles or marketing copy. Missing for 10: documented event-triggered rule/workflow builder, examples of arbitrary actions fired on specific events, depth on the transformation rules (docs-8 is title-only), hands-on or independent corroboration.
